solution.what: George Lasry (with ChatGPT Astra 6 and Anthropic Opus 5.5) transcribed and deciphered the item: 15/15 pages transcribed; 9/11 cipher pages deciphered; 2 more in part; 440 elements, 370 identified (84.1%); 4 assumed readings; 50 ?. Report section: see report.

Spot-check against the Gallica image (https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/btv1b52517729k/f67.item): f32r = Solferino telegram "Cavriana 24 juin 1859, Empereur a Imperatrice", clear text + code "941 325 274 1155 / 163 1142 1162"; his key gives 274=connais, 163=ble, 1142=s (fragmentary, no excerpt covers this run); f19r/f35r excerpts not image-checked Verdict: partly confirmed.

Jozef Krajčovič (issue #39) re-read f9r, f15r, f17r, f18r by hand and applied Lasry's key (not a ciphertext-only re-solution): agreements e.g. f15r sans résistance, f18r Castiglione; proposed token corrections f9r 1143->1193 (419 = es), f18r 1268->1265, f15r 1115->1155, f17r 839->889 and 353->355, provisional 1200 = sort; f21r-v (Emperor to the War Ministry) is a different nomenclator. Not applied: the transcription and key are Lasry's; passed to him. Extent corrected from 'already solved' to read in part (9 of 11 cipher pages, 84.1% of elements).

George Lasry's answer to issue #39: f9r 1193, f18r 1265, f15r 1155, f17r 889 and 355 are already in his transcription (1143, 1268, 1115, 839, 353 are not in it). Not adopted: f9r is 501 459 1193 (459 = es, not 419) and 432 1210 85 (1210 = sort, not 1200), checked on the image; f17r line 2 is 151 = bataille, not 751, giving une bataille sur Chiese and keeping 1325 = une; f17r ends 868 = o, not 808. No change to his transcription or key. Token streams: lasry_tokens_f9_f15_f17_f18.tsv.

Full texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): Lasry's tokens for ff. 9r, 15r, 17r, 18r, his report excerpts and Krajčovič's corrections listed; the full transcription and decryption of all 15 pages are still to come from Lasry.

Reading audit, per-document pass (George Lasry's sentence test): the token table of ff. 9r, 15r, 17r, 18r read in order builds French sentences (C overturned to B); the report excerpts read (A); Krajcovic's corrections file is not prose. fraction_read 0.841 (Lasry's identified elements, his full text not in the repository) -> about 0.31, estimated from what the repository holds.

v3 verification: entry scored on Lasry's token tsv (no reading). Values divided into words in texts/eugenie1859_f9_f18_reading.md: 0.625 explicit-hole, plain 0.5 (place names). Keeps read, now with a reading file.

Verification 5 (plain-bar rows): ff. 9r-18r reading plain 0.5, explicit 0.625; the holes are place names and the unvalued run at the end of 15r: keeps read. The report-excerpt file was scored with its English and page furniture (plain 0.488); the French excerpts written to texts/eugenie1859_lasry_excerpts_reading.md, plain 1.0. Keeps read.

Consistency pass (cl): 'read in part' not justified: Lasry's full decipherment is not in the repository and has not been asked for (not-attempted kept), retry step not done; NOTES already Status: in progress.

Of the four windows under the plain bar, two fail only on place names (Chiese, Mincio; Lonato, Castiglion) with defendront and the excerpt's end [...]; one on s'agenouillai[ent]/exaltes and one [?]; the real hole is the end of f. 15r, a run of tokens Lasry left without values ('Je re[?] [?] des [?] le [?] ... par ennemi'). Read as a reader 6 of 8 hold, and the folios are excerpts of Lasry's decipherment (four of eleven pages). Keeps read, the 15r run having no key material here (Lasry's values are all the repository holds). Earlier: v3 verification 23 Oct 2026: the entry pointed at the token tsv (one value per row; 0.0), so it had no reading. Worked: Lasry's values divided into words per folio in texts/eugenie1859_f9_f18_reading.md (letters the values do not carry bracketed: s'agenouillai[ent], etai[en]t; his ? tokens as [?]): 0.625 explicit-hole (5/8 sentence windows, hole rate 0.078), plain 0.5, the unknown words being place names (Oglio, Chiese, Mincio, Lonato, Castiglion) and defendront/exaltes. ff. 9r, 17r, 18r and the first sentence of 15r read; the end of 15r is a run of unvalued tokens.
